name: April
summary: The spring shoulder month — break crowds thin, the northern parks open their seasons, and the weather is kind everywhere except the odd late storm.

verdict.short: April at these parks: a good window with known trade-offs. The spring shoulder month.
worstFor: Guaranteed full daily operation in the north

crowds.shape: The spring shoulder month — break crowds thin, the northern parks open their seasons, and the weather is kind everywhere except the odd late storm.
peakWindows: The Easter week, wherever it falls

cost.note: Ticket prices move by date at every park on this site; the level describes the month's overall shape rather than any single day.

planningNotes.heading: The month in one decision
body: The northern Six Flags parks open their seasons across April — check the specific park's calendar, because opening weekends run reduced lineups and hours.

planningNotes.heading: The detail that matters
body: Late April is one of the calendar's genuine sweet spots: full-ish operation, thin crowds, mild weather.

freshness.sourceNote: Crowd and cost shapes describe multi-year patterns across the ten parks rather than a forecast for any single year. Weather figures are climate normals for each region and do not decay; the Texas figures blend the DFW and San Antonio areas, and the Southern California figures blend the coastal and inland valleys.
